issues.detail: The proper names זֶבַח (Zebah) and צַלְמֻנָּע (Zalmunna) are rendered as '祭物' (sacrifice/offering) and '撒勒穆拿' respectively. '祭物' is not a transliteration of Zebah but a common noun meaning 'sacrifice', which misidentifies the king's name. The Hebrew clearly lists two personal names, Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.
